description: For an unspecified approach-to-door goal, wait outside the observed target plane. User-specified numeric distances remain separate and take precedence.

waiting_zone.distance_definition: minimum signed horizontal distance from the configured robot footprint to the observed target plane, on its approach side

doorway_exit_margin_note: Requested clearance beyond the observed entrance plane; not a measurement of an unseen jamb's thickness. Offline evaluation separately checks the actual far edge.
